content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text evaluates a defender's multi-verse answer to a pressed link and declares it underdetermined because no text's own words state the contrary, so it is deciding the kind of chain-collision issue K-C governs.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"neither text's own words state the other reading's contrary.","rule_words":"When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.","room":"the pressing side's own chain read together / no one of them states the contrary in its own words: I weighed whether the defender's cited verses must be weighed as a chain by footing, or whether the judge may find Matthew 1:16 underdetermined because no individual verse states the contrary in its own words.","why":"The judge text uses the retired stating-verse test and does not weigh the defender's chain against the challenger's chain by footing."}
